messages:
marta: Heads-up: prepping onprem packaging for customer X scheduled 03/16 02:00 UTC change window. Need final signer handoff + fallback matrix. Can we lock artifacts and pins by EOD PT today? @ashok
ashok: On it. Packaging job started locally. ETA for sealed bundle + cosign: ~2.5h. Will push metadata to staging bucket: gs://redwood-private-staging/customerX/20260316-02
deploybot: deploybot: canary job queued for channel=eng-releases, release=private-2026.03.16, window=02:00-04:00 UTC
lina: Quick Q: for the KMS rotation we discussed, are keys already staged in customer's HSM? If not we'll need to delay signing.
kevin: Keys are staged. Verified with ops: key-id=projects/retail-prod/locations/global/keyR001. Verified cosign step locally `cosign sign --key ...` works. @lina
marta: Perfect. Two asks: (1) packager to produce both signed OCI repotree + shrinkwrap tarball; (2) release notes snippet for customer ops: include rollback trigger + checklist. I'll draft notes unless someone else has it.
simon: I can draft rollback criteria. Principle: if canary 10% FDs show >500ms p95 latency or >1.5x error rate vs baseline -> abort and roll back to release private-2026.02.28. Need TTL for signer unpin: 1h.
nashok: Packaging output paths: `s3://redwood-artifacts/private/customerX/20260316/manifest.json` and `s3://.../shrinkwrap.tar.gz`. Cosign sigs at `.sig` alongside tarball. Checksum SHA256 in manifest.
packaging-bot: packaging-bot: artifact uploaded s3://redwood-artifacts/private/customerX/20260316/shrinkwrap.tar.gz (size 124MB). manifest.json uploaded. Checksums match. cosign sig present.
lina: Thanks. One more: network mirror will pull artifacts from our staging SFTP. Ensure `manifest.fetch_timeout` set to 15m. Also include alternate mirror URL in metadata.
kevin: Added alt mirror: `https://mirror.alt.example/customerX/20260316/`. Updated manifest and re-signed. New signature pushed.
deploybot: deploybot: canary can be started once ops confirms `manifest.verify()` success and packaging-signer TTL is >= 60m. Current signer-ttl=90m.
drew: drew: Verified manifest.fetch and cosign sig on mirror. md5 vs sha256 cross-check good. Initiating canary seed rollout to 3 hosts in us-west1 now.
simon: Canary metrics hooks: set alert for `model-serving.error_rate`, `kv-cache-miss-rate`, and `p95_token_latency`. Dashboard link: https://console/redwood/dashboards/canary/customerX
marta: I'll send the short release note to customer ops + the rollback playbook. Draft:
- Rollout window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
- Canary: 3 hosts -> 30% -> full
- Rollback trigger: latency or error delta per simon
- Rollback steps: `deploybot rollback private-2026.02.28`
- Contact: oncall + marta
Anyone edit?
kevin: Edit: add 'pin installer image tag to sha256:<hash>' in checklist. Also include 'stop mirror pull' step on rollback.
drew: Canary started: deploybot reports success for first host. Logs: 
```ndeploybot: host-1: pulled shrinkwrap, verified signature, started installer
installer: stage 1 ok
```
Watching metrics.
packaging-bot: packaging-bot: re-uploaded manifest with alt mirror timestamp. signature rotated. new manifest id=20260316-02a
simon: Canary 10% traffic observed. p95 tokens at baseline. No errors. Proceeding to 30% rollout in 10m unless we see regressions.
marta: Reminder: change window backup plan - if rollback required after 03:30 UTC, we'll need to coordinate data-migration rollback (longer outage). Prefer to abort early.
drew: Noted. If anything >critical I'll hit :phone: and run `deploybot abort` and then `deploybot rollback private-2026.02.28`.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled rollout step -> scaling to 30% in 10m. monitoring hooks active.
lina: One last ops note: don't forget to rotate KMS signing key TTL post-deploy to reduce exposure. I'll file follow-up ticket.
marta: Thanks team. I'll post release notes now and mark this thread closed unless we hit an issue. :thumbsup:
